shutdown.schedule_now: Use genuinely supported installed OS shutdown scheduling through ordinary native permissions. Verify actual host/timezone/current clock before absolute scheduling; retain a real schedule/logind/OS timer receipt. Prefer native OS schedule rather than relying on agent remaining active or a long sleep.
shutdown.checkpoint_before: Stop admissions and safely checkpoint all owned in-flight experiments/source/results before22:45; leave time to save actual uncommitted work, failures, baseline and rollback instructions. Do not kill unrelated processes early or discard data.
shutdown.preserve_existing_schedule: First inspect existing scheduled shutdown/timer metadata. If exact requested shutdown already exists verify/reuse it; do not duplicate, cancel or overwrite unrelated scheduled work. Conflicting schedule or insufficient native permission => report exact blocker, no privilege/security bypass.
shutdown.limitations: No firmware/driver/security/powerlimit/clock/provider/credential changes or new remote shell. One authorised power-off is the only new system action. No restart/reboot or earlier shutdown.
